---
title: "Sampling map"
---

Where in the Florida Keys and on the west Florida shelf have MBeRCS cruises
sampled? The land outlines below are drawn from a small vendored
Natural Earth extract (`assets/florida-land.geojson`), so the maps render
offline.

```{python}
#| echo: false
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import sfer_common as sfer

sfer.style()
df = sfer.load()

LON = (-85.4, -79.7)
LAT = (24.2, 29.0)


def map_axes(ax):
    sfer.plot_basemap(ax)
    ax.set_xlim(*LON)
    ax.set_ylim(*LAT)
    ax.set_aspect(1 / np.cos(np.radians(np.mean(LAT))))
    ax.grid(True, color="#d9d9d9", lw=0.5)
    ax.set_xlabel("Longitude")
    ax.set_ylabel("Latitude")
```

## All sample locations

```{python}
#| fig-cap: "Every discrete sample in the dataset, coloured by station type."
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(8, 6.5))
map_axes(ax)

for stype, color, marker in [("C", "#1f78b4", "o"), ("F", "#e08214", "^")]:
    sub = df[df["station_type"] == stype]
    ax.scatter(sub["lon_dec"], sub["lat_dec"], s=6, c=color, marker=marker,
               alpha=0.35, linewidths=0, label=f"Type {stype} (n={len(sub):,})")

ax.legend(loc="upper left", markerscale=3)
ax.set_title("MBeRCS discrete sample locations")
plt.tight_layout()
```

Samples carry one of two upstream station-type codes. **Type C** samples span
the full water column (surface, mid and bottom), while **Type F** samples are
always surface samples. Both types follow the Florida Keys reef tract and the
west Florida shelf.

## Spatial coverage by year

```{python}
#| echo: false
years = sorted(df["year"].dropna().unique())
for y in years:
    sub = df[df["year"] == y]
    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(8, 6))
    map_axes(ax)
    ax.scatter(sub["lon_dec"], sub["lat_dec"], s=6, c="#1f78b4", alpha=0.5, linewidths=0)
    ax.set_title(f"Sample locations in {int(y)}  (n={len(sub):,})")
```

The footprint expands over time: early cruises concentrated in the Lower Keys,
with coverage later spreading north and west across the shelf.

## Station usage

```{python}
#| echo: false
from IPython.display import Markdown, display

station_counts = df["station"].value_counts()
top = ", ".join(f"{s} ({n})" for s, n in station_counts.head(5).items())
display(Markdown(
    f"**{df['station'].nunique():,} distinct stations** were occupied across the "
    f"record. The busiest were {top}."))
print()
print(df.groupby("station_type", observed=True).agg(
    samples=("keyfield", "size"),
    stations=("station", "nunique"),
    years=("year", lambda s: f"{int(s.min())}\u2013{int(s.max())}"),
))
```
